words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: He gave some good points in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一些很好的观点。
words.en: The positive aspects or qualities of someone or something.

words.ex: His strength helped him lift the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他的力量让他举起了那个重箱子。
words.en: The quality or state of being physically strong.

words.ex: The disadvantage of living far away is long commute time.
words.ex_cn: 住得远的劣势是通勤时间长。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: The downside of this job is the long hours.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的负面是工作时间很长。
words.en: The downside of something is the aspect of it which is less positive, pleasant, or useful than its other aspects.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.ex: The jury gave a guilty verdict.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团作出了有罪裁决。
words.en: A verdict is a decision made after a lot of consideration, especially one made by a jury in a court of law.

words.ex: He works in the chemistry lab after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在化学实验室工作。
words.en: A chemistry lab is a facility that provides controlled conditions in which scientific or technological research, experiments, and measurement may be performed.

words.tr: phrase. 机房；轮机舱（船上引擎所在的空间）
words.ex: The technician works in the engineer room to fix the servers.
words.ex_cn: 技术员在机房修理服务器。
words.en: The engineer room is a designated area on a ship or in a building where engineers work and where machinery is located.

words.ex: He is a beginner in piano lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他是钢琴课的初学者。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and has not yet mastered it.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.ex: The editor corrected the grammar in the article.
words.ex_cn: 编辑纠正了这篇文章的语法。
words.en: An editor is a person who is in charge of a newspaper or magazine and who decides what will be published in it.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.ex: The teacher will classify the students by age.
words.ex_cn: 老师将按年龄对学生进行分类。
words.en: To classify things means to divide them into groups or types so that things with similar characteristics are in the same group.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.ex: He works as an office assistant in a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司担任办公室助理。
words.en: An office assistant is a person who helps to manage the day-to-day operations of an office, performing tasks such as answering phones, scheduling appointments, and organizing files.

words.tr: phrase. 年轻人群体；时髦年轻人的圈子
words.ex: The young set loves to dance at weekend parties.
words.ex_cn: 年轻人喜欢在周末派对上跳舞。
words.en: A group or collection of young people, often sharing common interests or characteristics.

words.tr: phrase. 学习能力较弱的学生；成绩较差的学生
words.ex: The teacher helps weaker students with their homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师帮助学习较差的学生做作业。
words.en: Students who are less strong or less able in a particular area, especially academically.

words.tr: phrase. 项目团队；负责特定项目的协作小组
words.ex: The project team finished the work on time.
words.ex_cn: 项目团队按时完成了工作。
words.en: A group of individuals working together to achieve a common goal or complete a specific project.

words.tr: phrase. 获得信心；增强自信
words.ex: He gains confidence after practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习后增强了信心。
words.en: To acquire or develop self-assurance.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守规则；服从规定
words.ex: The children obey rules at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校遵守规则。
words.en: To follow instructions or regulations without question.

words.ex: He practiced interview skills before the job interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试前练习了面试技巧。
words.en: The abilities and techniques that enable someone to perform well in job interviews, including communication, presentation, and the ability to answer questions effectively.

words.tr: phrase. 时间管理技能；指有效规划和控制时间以提高效率的能力
words.ex: He improved his time management skills to finish homework faster.
words.ex_cn: 他提高了时间管理技能，以便更快地完成作业。
words.en: The ability to use one's time effectively or productively, especially at work.

words.tr: phrase. 示范与建议；展示和提议
words.ex: The teacher gave a demonstration and suggestion for solving the problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师做了演示并给出了建议来解决这个问题。
words.en: A presentation of information or ideas followed by advice or recommendations.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: He bought a new textbook for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他为数学课买了一本新教科书。
words.en: A textbook is a book containing a comprehensive compilation of content in a branch of study with the intention of explaining it. Textbooks are produced to meet the needs of educators, usually at educational institutions.

words.ex: The builder bought new materials for the house.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工人为房子买了新材料。
words.en: Materials are substances or things used to make or build something, or to provide information or evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 网络连接；互联网连接
words.ex: The internet connections in this town are slow.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的互联网连接很慢。
words.en: The means by which individuals or devices link to the internet, enabling access to a vast network of information and services.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the white board.
words.ex_cn: 老师在白板上写字。
words.en: A white board is a shiny white surface on which you can write and draw with non-permanent markers and then wipe off what you have written or drawn.

words.ex: He read the booklet about the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他读了那本关于新规则的小册子。
words.en: A booklet is a small, thin book that has a paper cover and that gives you information about something.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.tr: n. 复制品；副本；“copy”的复数； v. 复制；拷贝；
words.ex: He bought two copies of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他买了两本这本书的复制品。
words.en: Copies are duplicates of an original document, artwork, or other items made by various methods such as photocopying, printing, or digital replication.

words.tr: phrase. 暗室设施；用于冲洗和处理胶片或相纸的专用房间及其设备
words.ex: The school has darkroom facilities for photography class.
words.ex_cn: 学校有供摄影课使用的暗房设施。
words.en: Specialized rooms for developing photographs in complete darkness.

words.ex: He uses a tape recorder to practice English.
words.ex_cn: 他用录音机练习英语。
words.en: A tape recorder is a device used for recording and playing back sound on magnetic tape.

words.ex: He wrote his name on a sheet of paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在一张纸上写了名字。
words.en: A sheet of paper is a single piece of paper, especially one that is part of a larger piece or that is used for a specific purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 月刊；每月出版一次的杂志
words.ex: He reads a monthly magazine about cars.
words.ex_cn: 他读一本关于汽车的月刊。
words.en: A monthly magazine is a periodical publication that is issued once every month, containing articles, stories, photographs, and advertisements on various topics.

words.tr: n. 开头；开端； v. 开始；着手；“begin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The beginning of the story is very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的开头非常精彩。
words.en: The point in time or space at which something starts.

words.ex: He picked a random number to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他随意选了一个数字来赢得奖品。
words.en: If you describe something as random, you mean that it happens or is chosen without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: The measurement of temperature is important in science.
words.ex_cn: 温度的衡量在科学中很重要。
words.en: The action of measuring something.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr: phrase. 关键文本；核心文献；重要著作
words.ex: He reads key texts for his history class.
words.ex_cn: 他为历史课阅读重要文本。
words.en: Essential or foundational written works that are central to a subject or field of study.

words.tr: n. 标准；尺度；准则；“criterion”的复数；
words.ex: The main criteria for selection are skill and experience.
words.ex_cn: 选择的主要标准是技能和经验。
words.en: A criterion is a standard or principle by which something is judged or decided.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.tr: n. 介绍信；参考；引用；提及；“reference”的复数；
words.ex: He gave me three references for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他给我提供了三封介绍信用于这份工作。
words.en: References are mentions of something or someone, or the act of looking at something for information.

words.ex: He read three articles about history.
words.ex_cn: 他读了三篇关于历史的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or journal. It can also refer to a particular item or object, especially one of a set, or a clause in a legal document.

words.ex: He drew a graph to show the temperature changes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个图表来显示温度变化。
words.en: A graph is a mathematical diagram which shows the relationship between two or more sets of numbers or measurements.

words.ex: He finished his homework task before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了他的作业任务。
words.en: A task is a piece of work to be done or undertaken.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.tr: n. 清单；检查表；备忘录；目录册；
words.ex: He made a checklist for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为旅行列了一份清单。
words.en: A checklist is a list of items required, things to be done, or points to be considered, used as a reminder.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: He is a well-organized student.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有条理的学生。
words.en: Arranged or structured in an efficient and effective way.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.ex: He inserts a coin into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他把一枚硬币放进机器里。
words.en: To put or introduce something into something else.

words.ex: The article has clear subheadings to help readers find information.
words.ex_cn: 这篇文章有清晰的小标题，帮助读者找到信息。
words.en: Subheadings are headings given to subsections within a larger piece of writing. They help to organize the text and make it easier for the reader to follow.

words.ex: He wrote three paragraphs for his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的作文写了三段。
words.en: A paragraph is a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The start of a paragraph is often indicated by a new line and sometimes by indentation.

words.ex: The document uses a clean font.
words.ex_cn: 这个文档使用了一种简洁的字体。
words.en: A font is a set of printable or displayable text characters in a specific style and size.

words.tr: adj. 应给的；预期的；到期的；
words.ex: The payment is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这笔款项明天应给。
words.en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

words.tr: adj. 不精确的；不准确的；有错误的；
words.ex: The clock is inaccurate and shows the wrong time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟不精确，显示的时间不对。
words.en: If a statement or measurement is inaccurate, it is not correct or not exact.

words.ex: The ticket is invalid because it expired.
words.ex_cn: 这张票无效，因为它已经过期了。
words.en: If something is invalid, it is not legally or officially acceptable, or it is not based on truth or reason.

words.tr:
n. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
v. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
words.ex: The flight had a delay because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，航班推迟了。
words.en: If you delay doing something, you do not do it immediately or at the planned or expected time, but you leave it until later.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: His submission to the boss ended the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 他对老板的屈服结束了这场冲突。
words.en: The act of submitting something to someone for their decision or consideration; the state of being submissive or obedient.

words.tr: adj. 七倍的；七重的; adv. 七倍地
words.ex: The population grew sevenfold in ten years.
words.ex_cn: 十年间，人口增长了七倍。
words.en: Sevenfold is used to describe something that is seven times as much or as many.

words.tr: n. 错误；不合适；不真实
words.ex: The incorrectness of his answer surprised the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他答案的错误让老师感到惊讶。
words.en: Incorrectness refers to the state or quality of being incorrect; error.

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.tr: n. 依恋；附件；附加装置；
words.ex: The child showed strong attachment to his teddy bear.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对他的泰迪熊产生了强烈的依恋。
words.en: An attachment is a file that is sent along with an email message.

words.ex: The word 'hello' is written in italic.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'hello' 是用斜体写的。
words.en: Italic refers to a style of printing or writing in which the letters slope to the right.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: The seminar group discussed the book last week.
words.ex_cn: 研讨小组上周讨论了这本书。
words.en: A seminar group is a small group of people who meet regularly to discuss a particular subject or topic, often as part of a course of study.

words.tr: phrase. 目标清单；目的列表；任务目标一览
words.ex: He wrote a list of objectives for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他为这个项目写了一份目标清单。
words.en: A set of goals or aims that outline what is to be achieved.

words.ex: He wrote a project outline for his science fair.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的科学展览写了一个项目大纲。
words.en: A structured summary or plan that outlines the main objectives, key stages, and expected outcomes of a project or task.

words.ex: He does wide reading every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上广泛阅读。
words.en: The practice of reading a wide range of books or texts on various subjects to gain broad knowledge or understanding.

words.ex: He made a clear argument in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在文章中提出了一个清晰的论点。
words.en: A clear argument is a well-structured and easily understandable point or set of reasons given in support of an idea, action, or theory.

words.ex: He does design research to understand user needs.
words.ex_cn: 他做设计研究来了解用户需求。
words.en: Design research is a study of the process of designing, often with the aim of improving design practices and outcomes.

words.ex: He read three theory chapters last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了三章理论。
words.en: Sections of a book or course that explain fundamental concepts, principles, and frameworks, often forming the basis for practical application.

words.tr: phrase. 相关材料；有关资料；切题素材
words.ex: The teacher gave us relevant material for the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们与考试相关的材料。
words.en: Information or resources that are pertinent or directly related to a specific topic or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 新方法；新途径；新思路
words.ex: He uses a new approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种新方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A new way of dealing with something or thinking about something.

words.tr: phrase. 课堂笔记；课程记录
words.ex: I reviewed my class note before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 我在考试前复习了我的课堂笔记。
words.en: Written notes taken during a class or lecture.

words.tr: phrase. 独立学习；自主学习
words.ex: He practices independent learning every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天进行自主学习。
words.en: Independent learning refers to the process in which individuals take the initiative, with or without the assistance of others, in diagnosing their learning needs, formulating learning goals, identifying human and material resources for learning, choosing and implementing appropriate learning strategies, and evaluating learning outcomes.

words.ex: The scientist collects data every day.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天收集数据。
words.en: To gather information or statistics systematically for analysis.

words.tr: phrase. 会议报告；会议纪要
words.ex: He wrote a conference report last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周写了一份会议报告。
words.en: A conference report is a document that summarizes the discussions, decisions, and outcomes of a conference or meeting.

words.ex: The test is at the end of term.
words.ex_cn: 考试在学期末。
words.en: The period at the end of an academic term, typically marked by examinations and the conclusion of courses.

words.tr: phrase. 实验报告；实验室报告
words.ex: He wrote a laboratory report after the science experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学实验后写了一份实验报告。
words.en: A formal written account of the methods, observations, and results of a scientific investigation conducted in a lab.

words.ex: The movie will be filmed next month.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影下个月将被拍摄。
words.en: To be recorded on film or video.

words.tr: phrase. 技能重点；技能聚焦
words.ex: The skill focus of this course is writing clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的技能重点是清晰地写作。
words.en: A teaching or learning approach that concentrates on developing a specific ability or proficiency.

words.tr: phrase. 页码编排；页码编号；页码标注
words.ex: The book has automatic page numbering.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有自动页码编号。
words.en: The process of assigning numbers to the pages of a document or book.

words.tr: phrase. 电话面试；电话访谈
words.ex: He had a telephone interview yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天进行了一次电话面试。
words.en: A telephone interview is a conversation between a potential employer and a job applicant conducted over the telephone, typically as an initial screening process.

words.ex: The contents page shows the chapters and page numbers.
words.ex_cn: 目录页显示了章节和页码。
words.en: A page in a book or document that lists the titles of the chapters or sections and their corresponding page numbers.

words.tr: phrase. 口头陈述；口头报告；口头展示
words.ex: He gave an oral presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的口头报告。
words.en: An oral presentation is a formal, face-to-face speaking method intended to inform, persuade, or build goodwill towards a product, organization, or idea.

words.tr: phrase. 书面作业；写作任务
words.ex: He finished his written assignment before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了他的书面作业。
words.en: A task or piece of work that someone is required to complete in written form.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机加载的信息；由计算机载入的数据或资料
words.ex: The computer-loaded information shows the test results.
words.ex_cn: 计算机加载的信息显示了测试结果。
words.en: Information that has been loaded into a computer for processing or storage.

words.tr: phrase. 草稿版本；初步版本
words.ex: He wrote a draft version of his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇论文的初稿。
words.en: An early or preliminary version of a document or plan.

words.ex: He learned research methodology in his master's program.
words.ex_cn: 他在硕士课程中学习了研究方法。
words.en: Research methodology refers to the systematic, theoretical analysis of the methods applied to a field of study.

words.tr: phrase. 讨论结果；对某事的结果进行交流或分析
words.ex: They discuss the result after the test.
words.ex_cn: 他们在考试后讨论结果。
words.en: To talk about or consider the outcome or findings of something.

words.tr: phrase. 科学研究；科学探索
words.ex: He does science research in a lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室做科学研究。
words.en: Science research refers to systematic investigation into and study of materials and sources in order to establish facts and reach new conclusions, especially in the fields of natural and physical sciences.

words.tr: phrase. 分析材料；对某种物质或内容进行系统性的考察和解析
words.ex: The scientist will analyze material from the rock sample.
words.ex_cn: 科学家将分析岩石样本中的材料。
words.en: To examine and evaluate information or data in a systematic way to understand its meaning or structure.

words.tr: phrase. 邮寄调查；通过邮政方式发放的问卷调研
words.ex: They sent a postal survey to every household.
words.ex_cn: 他们给每户家庭寄了一份邮寄调查问卷。
words.en: A method of collecting data by sending questionnaires through the mail to a sample of individuals or households.

words.tr: phrase. 学习方法；学习手段
words.ex: He improved his learning methods to get better grades.
words.ex_cn: 他改进了学习方法以取得更好的成绩。
words.en: Learning methods refer to the various strategies and techniques used to acquire knowledge or skills.

words.tr: phrase. 阅读书目；书单（尤指课程指定的必读书目）
words.ex: He made a reading list for summer.
words.ex_cn: 他为夏天列了一份阅读清单。
words.en: A list of books, articles, or other materials recommended or required for reading, especially in an academic context.

words.tr: phrase. 被更好地排序；被更合理地安排顺序
words.ex: The lessons should be better sequenced to help students learn.
words.ex_cn: 课程应该更好地安排顺序，以帮助学生学习。
words.en: Arranged in a more logical or effective order.

words.ex: The bridge has a proper structure to support heavy trucks.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有合适的结构来承重卡车。
words.en: The correct or appropriate arrangement of parts or elements.

words.tr: phrase. 广泛的；大量的（用于描述种类繁多的选择）
words.ex: The store has a wide selection of shoes.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有各种各样的鞋子。
words.en: A large variety of options available.

words.ex: He attends three lectures every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周上三节讲课。
words.en: Lectures are talks that are given to a group of people to teach them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.tr: phrase. 商务沟通；商业中的信息交流
words.ex: Good communication in business helps teams work together.
words.ex_cn: 良好的商业沟通有助于团队合作。
words.en: The exchange of information in a professional or commercial setting.

words.tr: phrase. 人口研究；人口学；人口统计学
words.ex: He works in population studies at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学从事人口研究。
words.en: The scientific study of human populations, including their size, growth, density, distribution, and vital statistics.

words.tr: n. 计算机操作；计算； v. “compute”的现在分词；
words.ex: Computing helps us solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机操作帮助我们快速解决数学问题。
words.en: Computing is the activity of using computers and writing programs for them.

words.ex: He is taking sociology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习社会学。
words.en: Sociology is the study of society, patterns of social relationships, social interaction, and culture that surrounds everyday life.

words.tr: phrase. 专业知识；专门知识
words.ex: He has specialist knowledge in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有计算机科学方面的专业知识。
words.en: Specialist knowledge refers to expert understanding or skill in a particular subject or field, often acquired through extensive study or experience.

words.ex: He watches online tutorials to learn coding.
words.ex_cn: 他观看在线教程来学习编程。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching given by a tutor to an individual or a small group of students.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.ex: The loud music was a distraction while I tried to study.
words.ex_cn: 当我试图学习时，大声的音乐让我分心。
words.en: Something that makes it difficult for you to concentrate on what you are doing.

words.tr: phrase. 虚拟学习；指通过互联网或数字技术进行的在线教育或远程学习
words.ex: He attends virtual learning classes at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家参加在线学习课程。
words.en: Virtual learning refers to an environment where students study a curriculum taught by a teacher in a different location, using the internet and other digital tools.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoon every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通片。
words.en: A cartoon is a humorous drawing or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or a film made using animation techniques.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: He will resit the math exam next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将重考数学考试。
words.en: If someone resits an examination, they take it again, usually because they failed it the first time.

words.tr: phrase. 全球性的听力技能；指在跨文化或国际环境中理解与接收不同口音、语境和语言变体的英语听力能力
words.ex: Students need to develop global listening skills to understand accents from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要培养全球性的听力技能，以理解不同国家的口音。
words.en: Global listening skills refer to the ability to understand and interpret spoken language from various parts of the world, including different accents, dialects, and speeds of speech.

words.ex: The store uses video cameras to watch for thieves.
words.ex_cn: 商店使用摄像机来监视小偷。
words.en: Cameras designed to record moving images, commonly used for surveillance, broadcasting, or personal recording.

words.ex: He is doing exam preparation every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都在做考试准备。
words.en: The process of getting ready for an examination, involving study and practice.

words.tr: phrase. 职业课程；职业技能培训课程
words.ex: He is taking a vocational course in car repair.
words.ex_cn: 他正在参加一门汽车维修的职业课程。
words.en: A vocational course is a type of education that focuses on providing practical skills and knowledge for a specific job or career.

words.ex: He made a slide presentation for his science class.
words.ex_cn: 他为科学课做了一个幻灯片演示。
words.en: A slide presentation is a series of slides that are shown to an audience to explain or illustrate a topic.

words.ex: They had a group discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们就作业进行了一次小组讨论。
words.en: A group discussion is a conversation among a group of people on a specific topic, where everyone is encouraged to contribute their ideas and opinions.

words.w: focus on glass and green waste
words.tr: 短语. 专注于玻璃和绿色废弃物（如园林垃圾）的处理或回收
words.ex: They focus on glass and green waste in their recycling program.
words.ex_cn: 他们在回收计划中专注于玻璃和厨余垃圾。
words.en: To concentrate efforts on processing glass and organic waste materials.

words.tr: phrase. 统计引擎设计：指构建用于收集、处理和分析统计数据的软件系统或模块的架构与实现方法
words.ex: He designs a statistics engine for data analysis.
words.ex_cn: 他为数据分析设计了一个统计引擎。
words.en: The development of systems that collect, analyze, and present data.
